text:
amanda: quick Q — where's the easiest saved search for filtering logs by org=acme, model=redwood-llama, route=/generate, region=eu-west? I want to look at errors and latency spikes for a customer report.
chris: try the LogSearch saved view I use: https://logs.redwood.ai/app/search/saved/acme-gen-route-eu :point_right: it's under Ops > Saved Views
liam: if you're building on a fresh query, this works:
```
org:acme AND model:\"redwood-llama\" AND route:\"/generate\" AND region:eu-west
| stats count(), p50(latency_ms), p95(latency_ms) by status
| where status >= 400
```
nora: if you want to persist that, create a saved view and name it something like `acme:redwood-llama:/generate:eu-west` so it's unambiguous. steps: open query -> click Save view -> choose folder Ops -> save.
amanda: thanks — do we have an alert tied to this? want to surface 5xx spikes for them.
sam: there's an existing alert `ops-gen-route-5xx-eu` but it's org-agnostic. If you need customer-specific alerts we usually create a derived saved search + composite alert. ping me and I can help set it up.
chris: also FYI, if you need traces linked, add `trace_id` to your projection and use the Trace UI link template: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/{{trace_id}}
nora: i just created a saved view variant for you: `acme-gen-eu-route-errors` and put it in Ops > Saved Views. Should show up for anyone in the channel.
ops-bot: Saved view created: "Ops/acme-gen-eu-route-errors" by nora :white_check_mark:
amanda: perfect — can someone drop the link here? want to include it in the incident writeup.
chris: link: https://logs.redwood.ai/app/search/saved/Ops/acme-gen-eu-route-errors
liam: one more tip — if you plan to run long hunts, add `| sort @timestamp desc | limit 1000` so the dashboard doesn't time out.
amanda: awesome, thanks everyone :rocket:
